sloka: एवं स राजा तद्राज्यमकरोत्सपुरोहितः ।प्रहृष्टमनुजाकीर्णं देवराजं यथा वृषा ।। ७.७९.१९ ॥
transliteration: evaṁ sa rājā tadrājyamakarotsapurohitaḥ ।prahṛṣṭamanujākīrṇaṁ devarājaṁ yathā vṛṣā ।। 7.79.19 ॥

translations.english: Thus, that king (Shatrughna), with his priest, ruled that kingdom, which was filled with joyful people, just as Indra rules the kingdom of the gods.
